Programs such as the Eurofighter Typhoon capability upgrades, Airbus A400M modernisation activities, next-generation military avionics programs, and increasing investment in autonomous and connected air systems are driving the development of highly connected, safety-critical computing architectures. These initiatives rely heavily on advanced software, mission computing, avionics integration and robust certification processes to maintain Europe's technological and defence capabilities. For freelancers, this creates a unique opportunity. signals.source_text: MathWorks Research Summit is coming to India! After 17 editions of this flagship research and technology conference in Greater Boston and Tokyo, MathWorks is excited to host the inaugural India edition at our Bangalore office on October 27 and 28. The theme of this year's event will be Engineered System Design in the age of AI. What I’m personally most excited about isn’t just bringing the event to India. It’s the opportunity to build and grow a new research community. Many years ago, I started my career as an R&D engineer in India. A lot has changed since then. India’s research and innovation ecosystem has grown tremendously, as has the MathWorks footprint in the country. India has also become an increasingly important part of our research collaborations. The Summit gives us an opportunity to strengthen those existing relationships and build new ones. The goal of the gathering isn’t simply to present work. We want to learn from people across disciplines, have candid conversations about where research is headed, surface challenges that are both global and specific to India, and explore how a common technology platform and ecosystem can help move ideas from exploration to impact. Just as importantly, we hope to create connections that continue well beyond the two days of the Summit. That has been one of the most rewarding outcomes of previous editions, and I’m excited to see what comes from bringing this community together in India. Event registration is free, but by invitation. If you’re interested, you can nominate yourself or a colleague through the nomination form on our Research Summit series page: https://lnkd.in/eGKRTyRu #MathWorksResearchSummit #MathWorks #Research #Engineering #Innovation #India #Academia #MATLAB #Simulink Lakshminarayan Viju Ravichandran , Souvick Chatterjee

signals.source_text: During a technical review, I asked to see the training data and validation methodology behind a company's "AI-based multi-sensor classifier." What I got back was a fixed decision tree with manually tuned thresholds — no train/test split, no retraining pipeline, a "confidence score" that was really just a normalized distance metric with no calibration behind it. Here's the part people miss: that's not automatically a bad system. A deterministic, explainable rule-based classifier can be exactly the right architectural choice for a safety-critical decision path — arguably safer than a black-box model in a domain where you'll eventually have to explain your logic to a test pilot or an OT&E board. The actual problem was calling it "AI." That label invites the wrong due-diligence questions — where's your training data, how do you retrain, what's your drift monitoring — and forfeits the credit you'd get for being deterministic and auditable in a domain where explainability is a selling point, not a weakness. How you characterize your own architecture changes which questions you get asked. Answer the right ones on your own terms. #DoW #Defense #Autonomy #AI
